name: Palmetto Welding & Fabrication Services, LLC
old_description: Needed a pin and weld and was greeted with the best customer service, Amanda is amazing, and Michael is very knowledgeable. I highly recommend this shop to anyone looking for welding services. Among the rest ! ! !
about:
Palmetto Welding & Fabrication Services, LLC was founded in February 2019 by Amanda Koch and Michael Meyer in Summerville, South Carolina. The couple met in 2017 while Michael was working as a contract welder in Wyoming, and they relocated with their families to the Charleston area in 2018. Amanda brought 20 years of office management experience, primarily in oil and gas, while Michael had spent his career in welding across industries such as oil and gas, marine, nuclear, automotive, and structural steel.

The company provides structural steel fabrication and erection, miscellaneous steel fabrication and installation, and aluminum fabrication and erection. Its shop includes a plasma burn table capable of cutting plate up to 1 inch thick. In January 2020 the firm acquired a 9,500‑square‑foot facility on two acres and employed 17 skilled workers, with plans to expand into a 30,000‑square‑foot building in early 2022.

Palmetto Welding serves customers in construction, automotive, and general industrial markets. Testimonials highlight work on automotive trailing‑arm reinforcements and pin‑and‑weld services, while the company’s structural steel erection capabilities target commercial and industrial building projects. Michael Meyer’s background in nuclear and marine welding also informs the shop’s quality standards.

The business was started after Michael identified a local need for skilled, affordable welding services for both production and mobile work. The company says it differentiates itself through AISC certification in both fabrication and erection, which allows it to bid on projects with stringent quality‑control requirements, and through a commitment to adapting its operations to client needs.
